    def restore(self, saved: Dict[str, Any]):
        """Reinstate exactly the checkpointed state; the generation moves on."""
        self.cap = saved['cap'].copy()
        self.dem = saved['dem'].copy()
        self.slots = [list(row) for row in saved['slots']]
        self.mode = saved['mode']
        self.rho = saved['rho']
        self.rebuild_provider()
        self.amounts = [list(row) for row in saved['amounts']]
        self.slots = self.provider.slots
        self.barrier.load_state(saved['barrier'])
        state = saved['controller']
        self.coord.load_state({'Z': np.array(state['z'], copy=True),
                               'Z_old': np.array(state['z'], copy=True),
                               'dual': np.array(state['u'], copy=True),
                               'rho': state['rho'], 'iterate': 0})
        self._last_z = np.array(state['z'], copy=True)
        self._last_u = np.array(state['u'], copy=True)
        self.generation += 1


def run_case(case) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Replay one case into its per-event response."""
    return CaseSession(case).run()
